bridge_disconnected: Check the MT5 terminal and VantageBridgeEA on the VPS (deploy/MT5_GUI.md). New entries are blocked while the bridge is down; broker-side SL/TP still protect open positions, but partial closes and SL moves are paused.
terminal_disconnected: The MT5 terminal reports no broker connection. Check the terminal login and network. Partial closes and SL moves cannot run until it reconnects.
ea_version_mismatch: The executor speaks bridge protocol v2. Attach VantageBridgeEA v2 (or roll the worker back) per VANTAGE_EXECUTION_GUIDE.md §17. Keep execution mode disabled until versions match.
submit_unknown: An entry order was sent but its outcome is unknown. It is never resent. Check the MT5 terminal for a position or order with the trade set comment; the reconciler resolves it automatically when the bridge answers.
partial_close_failed: A partial take-profit could not be closed after its retries. Close the checkpoint volume manually in MT5 if needed, then acknowledge.
sl_modify_failed: A stop-loss move (break-even, trailing or after-checkpoint) failed repeatedly. Verify the position stop in MT5; the broker-side SL from the previous move still applies.
protection_missing: A filled position could not be confirmed to carry its stop loss. Check the position in MT5 now and set the SL manually if it is missing.
unknown_position: A position or order exists at the broker that no trade set owns. The executor never touches it. Decide manually whether to keep or close it.
reconciliation_failed: Reconciliation against broker state is failing. Ambiguous orders and stale states are not being resolved. Check the bridge and SQLite.
firestore_unavailable: Operational storage is unavailable. New entries are blocked. Check local disk space, file permissions, SQLite integrity and service logs; broker-side stops remain in force.
config_invalid: Execution configuration is invalid, so new entries are blocked. Open Settings / Profiles, fix the reported fields, and re-activate a valid profile.
service_unhealthy: A ByTrader role stopped reporting a healthy heartbeat. Check the independently supervised Go service and its logs. An offline executor cannot close positions; broker-side stops remain in force.
signal_dead_letter: A signal event exhausted its retries and was not executed. Review it under Signals; requeue it only if it is still relevant, or discard it.
signal_backlog: Signal events are waiting longer than expected. Check the executor service, the bridge and SQLite.
signal_publish_failed: The forwarder could not hand a signal event to SQLite and has spooled it locally; it retries automatically. If this persists, check SQLite access from the forwarder.
close_all_failed: Emergency close-all did not close every owned position. Close the remaining positions manually in MT5. The kill switch stays engaged.
clock_skew: The MT5 terminal clock (TimeGMT) and the worker clock disagree. New entries are refused until they agree within the limit. Check NTP on the VPS (timedatectl) and the terminal time; see mql5/PROTOCOL.md "Time bases".
correlation_mismatch: The broker did not keep the order comment the executor uses to recognise its trades. Duplicate protection and SUBMIT_UNKNOWN resolution depend on it. Set execution mode to disabled and read docs/project_memory/VANTAGE_BROKER_ASSUMPTIONS.md (correlation fallback) before trading again.
mutation_unknown: Inspect the trade intent and exact broker ticket state. Keep new entries disabled until reconciliation resolves the outcome; never repeat an unresolved broker mutation.
